notes: Authored planning motions and support assumptions, not solved contact dynamics or qualified construction capacity.
350 kg proposed payload envelope is unqualified; kit column mass is 327.858 kg (carrier-construction-v1).

Vertical timing uses the representative measured loaded speed .01174 m/s; other payloads remain unverified. Four external climbing lanes reserve loaded ascent, dock and empty descent; two carriers alternate per lane.

Locked reversible foundation base seats provisionally restrain individual first columns until beam and brace connections exist. Ground-qualified reversible pile groups are assumed; soil, lateral resistance, wind and staged structure require engineering qualification.
The ground entrance aligns with the stair/core entrance; opaque core-half entrance surrounds are provisional and exterior weather qualification remains unverified.
Completed scope: foundations, frame/braces, floors, modular stair/core, service risers, facade, terraces, planting and roof; commissioning and interior fit-out remain outside this demonstration.
